_page_meta.title: Resources — Pranav PT
_page_meta.description: Curated reads on Python, AI, Automation, and Finance Technology. Articles and guides written to make complex concepts simple.

_content_model.how_it_works: Each resource item has a 'slug'. The full article content lives in content/resources/[slug].md. The list page reads from this JSON. The detail page at /resources/[slug] reads and renders the MD file.
_content_model.adding_content: To add a new resource: (1) Add an entry to the categories[n].items array below. (2) Create the file content/resources/[slug].md with the full article content.
_content_model.md_frontmatter: Each .md file MUST begin with this exact frontmatter block or the detail page will throw a runtime error:
_content_model.md_frontmatter_template:
---
title: "Article Title"
description: "One sentence for SEO meta description"
category: "Python"
read_time: "6 min"
published_date: "2026-05-27"
---

detail_page_layout._dev_note: The detail page renders the .md file content. Use @tailwindcss/typography (prose classes) for article body styling. Back link at top returns to /resources.
